page.layout: Running head at top right; page number top left. Two parallel columns, each with a two-part header ("Menses Iul." and "Menses Coptitarum."): left column, lines 20 to 26 with the Payni, Iunij, Epiphi markers; right column, lines 27 to 3 with the Iulij, Mesori, Aug. markers. Catchword-like line "4 — F" below the right column at right.

main_text.l: Menses Iul. | Menses Coptitarum. | Menses Iul. | Menses Coptitarum.

page.notes: Calendar table with no headings. Cells are separated by " | ": Julian day, letter, Coptic day. Marker words (Payni., Iunij, Epiphi, Iulij, Mesori, Aug.) stand beside their lines and are kept as printed. The right edge of the scan cuts the right-hand header ("Coptitarum" is partly lost) and the outer numbers of the right column. Some dashes and letter positions are approximate because of the printed ruling. "4 — F" at bottom right is treated as a catchword. No marginal notes or reference marks are printed.
